name: Happy Path - Standard Sales Order Processing
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid OrderTypeCode 'YORB' routed to SalesOrder branch
expected_outcome: Message is processed through Message Mapping 1, headers enriched, and ends at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 200/OneWay ACK
validates: CallActivity_4 header enrichment, SequenceFlow_82 routing expression, CallActivity_102 mapping execution, CallActivity_13 header logging

name: Happy Path - Return Sales Order Processing
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with return order indicator satisfying ReturnSalesOrder route condition
expected_outcome: Message is routed via SequenceFlow_113 to CallActivity_71 and terminates successfully at EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 SO Return create branch condition evaluation and CallActivity_71 generic header processing

name: Boundary & Routing Exception - Unmatched Route Escalation
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with non-qualifying order criteria triggering default gateway path
expected_outcome: ExclusiveGateway_80 falls back to default SequenceFlow_110, raising EscalationEndEvent 'RoutingConditionNotMet' at EndEvent_11
validates: Default route behavior, EscalationEndEvent error code generation, and routing fault containment

name: Error Handling - Mapping Failure and Exception Subprocess Invocation
trigger: Inbound SOAP message containing malformed XML structure causing Message Mapping (CallActivity_102) failure
expected_outcome: Exception caught by SubProcess_91; CallActivity_97 restores original payload from property.InputPayload, CallActivity_100 logs error payload, terminating at EndEvent_95
validates: SubProcess_91 ErrorStartEvent, property.InputPayload retention in CallActivity_4, attachment creation in Log_Payload script, EndErrorEvent

name: Edge Case - Null/Empty Optional Metadata Headers
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with minimal payload missing custom header configuration values (Region, Country, TimeStamp)
expected_outcome: Content Modifier handles missing properties gracefully, Interface_Generic_Headers skips null property logs without NPE, message completes
validates: Null-safety in Groovy scripts and default expression fallbacks in Content Modifier CallActivity_4
